# Properly extract match function with line numbers stripped
match_start = original.find('def match(version, match_expr):')
if match_start >= 0:
    rest = original[match_start:]
    lines = rest.split('\n')
    func_lines = [lines[0]]  # First line is the def
    
    base_indent = len(lines[1]) - len(lines[1].lstrip()) if len(lines) > 1 else 0
    
    i = 1
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if line.strip() == '':
            func_lines.append(line)
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Strip leading line number (digits followed by tab)
        stripped = line.lstrip()
        # Check if it starts with a number and tab
        import re
        m = re.match(r'^\d+\t', stripped)
        if m:
            stripped = stripped[m.end():]
        
        func_lines.append(stripped)
        i += 1
    
    match_func_clean = '\n'.join(func_lines)
    print("Cleaned match function first 10 lines:")
    for l in match_func_clean.split('\n')[:10]:
        print(f"  {repr(l)}")
    
    print(f"\nTotal length: {len(match_func_clean)}")
else:
    print("match function not found")
